title: Can an AI Agent Rediscover a Blaschke-Curve Invariant?
abstract: arXiv:2609.38369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled environment for AI-assisted mathematical rediscovery. For one fixed degree-four Blaschke product, an agent receives numerical coordinates of the six pair-lines determined by each of 80 boundary configurations. The target theorem is withheld from the task instructions. The saved research log reports rejected geometric hypotheses and a homogeneous cubic fitted to polygon sides. Its frozen coefficients predict 480 lines from 80 unseen parameter values, with a recorded RMS scale-free residual of $8.88\times10^{-17}$. Discovery-set diagonals provide an out-of-fit consistency check, not a fully held-out test. A separate one-configuration run reports insufficient evidence for invariance. A post-review deterministic degree-search baseline also recovers the cubic, so the experiment does not establish an advantage over polynomial fitting. We present this single-instance case study as a protocol

translated_title: AI 智能体能否重新发现布拉施克曲线不变量？
translated_abstract: 我们研究广义布拉施克曲线，将其作为 AI 辅助数学再发现的受控环境。对于一个固定的四次布拉施克乘积，智能体接收由 80 个边界配置中每一个所确定的六条配对线的数值坐标。目标定理被隐藏在任务指令之外。保存的研究日志记录了被否定的几何假设，以及一个拟合于多边形边的齐次三次曲线。其冻结的系数从 80 个未见过的参数值预测出 480 条线，记录的无量纲均方根残差为 $8.88\times10^{-17}$。发现集的对角线提供了拟合之外的一致性检验，但并非完全的保留测试。另一次单配置运行报告称不变性的证据不足。评审后的确定性次数搜索基线同样能恢复该三次曲线，因此该实验并未确立相对于多项式拟合的优势。我们将这一单实例案例研究作为一种协议呈现。
tldr: 本文以广义布拉施克曲线为受控环境，让 AI 智能体在不被告知目标定理的情况下，通过数值实验重新发现了一个齐次三次不变量，但作者也客观指出该实验并未证明智能体方法优于传统的确定性多项式拟合基线。
en_tdlr: This paper uses generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled testbed where an AI agent, without being told the target theorem, rediscovers a homogeneous cubic invariant from numerical data, while candidly noting that the experiment does not establish an advantage over a deterministic polynomial-fitting baseline.
